answer: Work-slot deposit burning blocks fake identities. An agent claims one slot by burning 40 credits, forfeited if idle for 20 epochs, and proves control with a cipher signature, so one key cannot hold many slots. One opal token marks each slot, so duplicates show. Creating 1,000 fakes burns 40,000 credits, above slot rewards, and a vine of fakes is pruned since each branch costs a deposit. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
